title: Membership Candidate
description: Output of Membership Stage before Resolve. Contract from MEMBERSHIP_SSOT. Carries strategyRef and record identity for Resolve. No Modal, Strategy body, Ranking, Geometry, Dataset write. Membership algorithm / thresholds out of scope.

strategyRef.description: Strategy reference from the matched EnvelopeRecord. Used by Resolve after Membership. Not used as Membership judgment input.

recordIdentity.description: Logical identity of the matched EnvelopeRecord within the Published Dataset (e.g. stable key). Format out of scope.

membership.description: Membership Result flags. Structure only — how flags are computed is Out of Scope.

datasetIdentity.description: Optional reference to the Published Dataset Identity that produced this Candidate.
